title: BonePileFix - Valhelsia Structures
description: Fixes the Bone Pile block from Valhelsia Structures rendering vertically and ignores layer height when using Sodium or Embeddium. Unofficial visual fix, requires Valhelsia Structures installed.
body:
An unofficial visual fix for the **Bone Pile** block from [Valhelsia Structures](https://modrinth.com/mod/valhelsia-structures) when using **Sodium** or **Embeddium**.

Before
![BEFORE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01f12f250ec4adedb7165cf22d00f4895026d900.png)

After
![AFTER](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3dfeb664fc3448d6387e5cc3a70d1b1d1a6a89e1.png)

The Problem

When Sodium or Embeddium is installed, the Bone Pile block renders **vertically** instead of lying flat on the ground. This is caused by the original model using `minecraft:block/carpet` as its parent, which Sodium mishandles for mod-added blocks.

 What This Fix Does

-  Replaces the model with explicit flat geometry, bypassing the broken `carpet` parent
-  No textures from the original mod are included or redistributed
- Layer stacking visuals are partially affected due to a deeper incompatibility between Sodium and the mod's rendering Mixin — this cannot be fully resolved from a resource pack alone

Requirements

- [Valhelsia Structures](https://modrinth.com/mod/valhelsia-structures) `neoforge-1.21.1-1.1.2`
- Sodium or Embeddium (the bug does not occur without these)


Notes

This is an unofficial fix. All credit for the original mod goes to the [Valhelsia Team](https://github.com/ValhelsiaTeam).
The root cause has been reported to the developers — see the [GitHub issue](https://github.com/ValhelsiaTeam/Valhelsia-Structures/issues).
